question: What anatomical structures are connected by a vesicovaginal fistula?
explanation: A vesicovaginal fistula forms an abnormal tract specifically between the urinary bladder and the vagina, causing continuous urine leakage. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h1)

question: The primary physical symptom experienced by a patient with a vesicovaginal fistula is...

options.B: Inability to pass urine at all
options.D: Bright red bleeding from the uterus

explanation: Because urine bypasses the urethral sphincter through the fistula tract, it leaks continuously into the vagina. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h1)

question: The leading cause of vesicovaginal fistula in Nigeria is...
explanation: Prolonged and obstructed labor puts intense pressure on pelvic tissues, causing ischemia and fistula formation. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h2)

question: How does prolonged labor directly damage the bladder and vaginal tissue?

options.A: By introducing aggressive bacterial toxins directly
options.B: By overstretching the bladder smooth muscle
options.C: By causing ischemia through sustained pressure
options.D: By dissolving the mucosal lining with amniotic fluid

explanation: Pressure from the fetal head cuts off blood supply to the tissues, leading to tissue death and fistula creation. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h2)

question: When does urinary leakage typically begin after childbirth in a patient developing a VVF?

options.A: Only when the patient stands up suddenly
options.B: Several months after the menstrual cycle returns
options.C: Immediately during the second stage of labor
options.D: A few days postpartum as necrotic tissue sloughs

explanation: Dead tissue takes a few days to separate and slough off after ischemic injury, revealing the abnormal opening. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h3)

question: What is the purpose of instilling methylene blue dye during the evaluation of a suspected fistula?

options.A: To trace the leakage path and confirm the diagnosis
options.B: To stain the vaginal mucosa for a biopsy sample
options.C: To numb the bladder lining and reduce patient discomfort
options.D: To sterilize the bladder walls before surgical repair

explanation: The blue dye passes through the fistula opening, staining vaginal packing to visually confirm the tract. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h3)

question: A major skin integrity risk for patients with a vesicovaginal fistula is...

options.B: Diffuse fungal infections of the scalp
options.C: Pressure ulcers over the shoulder blades

explanation: Constant exposure of the perineal skin to urine causes severe irritation, breakdown, and excoriation. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h4)

question: Why is nutritional assessment particularly important prior to fistula repair surgery?

options.A: To promote optimal wound healing and tissue recovery
options.B: To eliminate the need for post-operative antibiotics
options.C: To stop the continuous involuntary flow of urine
options.D: To prevent the development of gestational diabetes

explanation: Good nutrition and correction of anemia are essential for proper tissue healing and successful surgical closure. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h4)

question: The primary goal of bladder catheterization after a VVF repair is to...

options.A: Flush out remaining methylene blue diagnostic dye
options.B: Measure the exact concentration of urinary protein
options.C: Keep the bladder continuously empty and tension-free
options.D: Deliver topical medications directly to the suture line

explanation: Continuous drainage prevents bladder distension, which would otherwise pull apart the fresh surgical sutures. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h5)

question: Why is encouraging a high fluid intake important during the post-operative recovery period?

options.A: To dilute the concentration of prescribed pain medications
options.B: To speed up the reabsorption of suture materials
options.C: To shrink the overall size of the urinary bladder
options.D: To prevent catheter blockage and maintain urinary flow

explanation: Good hydration flushes the catheter lumen and prevents clots or debris from blocking urine drainage. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h5)

question: A comprehensive recovery plan for a VVF survivor must include...

options.A: Immediate discharge home without follow-up care
options.B: Strict limitation of fluid intake for several months
options.C: Psychological support and social reintegration activities
options.D: Permanent prohibition from ever becoming pregnant again

explanation: Patients suffer severe emotional trauma, stigma, and isolation, making psychosocial rehabilitation a vital part of recovery. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h6)

question: Which strategy is most effective for preventing new cases of vesicovaginal fistula in Nigeria?

options.A: Increasing the availability of adult literacy classes
options.B: Distributing barrier contraceptives in rural markets
options.C: Providing timely access to emergency obstetric care
options.D: Administering prophylactic antibiotics to all pregnant women

explanation: Prompt intervention for obstructed labor prevents the prolonged tissue ischemia that causes fistula formation. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T12#GNS216_U5_T12_h6)
